records.title: Responsible Use of AI in Environmental Science
records.header: C ENV 200 Responsible Use of AI in Environmental Science (2)
records.text: C ENV 200 Responsible Use of AI in Environmental Science (2) Examines AI as a tool to support learning while emphasizing critical judgment, ethical reasoning, and responsibility. Explores the strengths and limitations of AI tools, their social-environmental impacts, and uses in environmental fields. Introduces prompt engineering and evaluating AI output for accuracy, bias, and limitations. Teaches use of AI to clarify complex ideas and explore alternative explanations while centering ethics and equity. Offered: AWSp.

records.title: FieldNotes - An Undergraduate Journal
records.header: C ENV 401 FieldNotes - An Undergraduate Journal (2, max. 6)
records.text: C ENV 401 FieldNotes - An Undergraduate Journal (2, max. 6) FieldNotes, an undergraduate journal connecting UW with the greater Puget Sound community, highlights student-led environmental research and outreach. FieldNotes, publishes two issues annually, features research communications, community features, and vivid imagery to ensure multi-faceted storytelling. Provides a platform for students to actively learn and engage in science communication. Offered: W.
